pr_title: ci: let a builder start its own Melian round in Actions

comments.comment: A head's biome.json that extends /proc/<pid>/environ makes static.biome fail with an error quoting the round job's logins, and the round comment and its artefact print that error.
comments.failureScenario: A head adds a biome.json of {"extends": ["/proc/<pid>/environ"]}, where <pid> is the round step's shell, which still holds MELIAN_CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN after unset. static.biome fails, and its error quotes the file. round.mjs prints that error into the round comment under Error:, and the workflow uploads the raw verdict, round.txt and round.err as the run artefact, so anyone who can read the pull request or the run reads the login.
